$comment: Privacy nutrition label — machine-readable mirror of APP_STORE_LISTING.md §5. Submit via App Store Connect API (POST /v1/apps/{id}/appPrivacyConfig) or paste into Manage Data Collection. Keys follow Apple's Data Types taxonomy as of App Store Connect API v3.7.

privacyChoices.comment: We collect data but do NOT use it for tracking per Apple's definition (no linking with other apps/sites for advertising, no sale to data brokers). ATT prompt is therefore not shown.

dataTypes.notes: Collected only if the user chooses phone-OTP sign-in. Stored on the user's account record; used for OTP verification and as an optional handle in neighbor chat. Never shared with third parties.

Collected only if the user chooses magic-link sign-in or Sign in with Apple without Hide-My-Email. Used for magic-link delivery and anchor support contact. SIWA private-relay addresses are accepted as first-class.
Display name is optional; default is 'Anonymous neighbor'. Used for post attribution only.

ZIP-code granularity (reducedAccuracy) only. Used in-memory for the current search. Not written to disk; not sent to server. ZIP-picker fallback always available. Anonymous browsers are not linked to the value.
The anonymous-post feature is the app's core; posts are linked to the authoring account server-side, displayed publicly per the user's chosen visibility.
Neighbor chat messages between an anchor and a post author. Linked to the two participating accounts server-side; end-to-end transport over TLS 1.3.
v1 post composer is text-only; no photo attachments, no Photos permission requested.
APNs push token, bound to the user's account after sign-in for notification delivery. Not linked for anonymous browsers.
Internal UUID per authenticated account. Never exposed to third parties, never used for advertising.
Sentry crash reports. PII is scrubbed client-side before upload via Sentry beforeSend hook (see apps/mobile/sentry.config.ts).
Sentry performance traces (transaction names, durations). No PII, no URL query strings.
Aggregate page-view counters and funnel metrics. No individual user attribution.
Resource-directory search queries are processed in-memory only; we do not persist a per-user search log.

dataRetention.policy: Accounts: until user deletes. Posts: retained 1 year after account deletion for abuse-investigation purposes, then purged. Diagnostics: 30 days rolling window in Sentry.
